{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# Three-phase ETADN DPO training on 3 GPUs (cuda:0, cuda:1, cuda:4).
#
# Phase 1 (parallel, 3 GPUs):
#   GPU 0: ETADN training (seed 42)
#   GPU 1: gamma sweep {0.85, 0.90, 0.92} (serial)
#   GPU 4: gamma sweep {0.95, 0.97, 1.0}  (serial)
#
# Phase 2 Round A (parallel, 3 GPUs):
#   GPU 0: ETADN seed=123
#   GPU 1: best-gamma seed=42
#   GPU 4: best-gamma seed=123
#
# Phase 2 Round B (parallel, 3 GPUs, after Round A):
#   GPU 0: ETADN seed=456
#   GPU 1: best-gamma seed=456
#   GPU 4: (idle)
#
# Final comparison:
#   ETADN 3 seeds:    {Phase1 s42, Phase2-A s123, Phase2-B s456}
#   best-gamma 3 seeds: {Phase2-A s42, Phase2-A s123, Phase2-B s456}
#
# Usage:
#   bash scripts/run_training.sh --data_path data/v9_dpo_pairs.jsonl
#   BEST_GAMMA=0.95 bash scripts/run_training.sh --data_path data/v9_dpo_pairs.jsonl

set -euo pipefail

# Activate conda
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

# Defaults
DATA_PATH="data/v9_dpo_pairs.jsonl"
MODEL_NAME="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen3-8B"
OUTPUT_BASE="outputs"
WANDB_PROJECT="etadn-dpo"

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
        --data_path) DATA_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --model_name) MODEL_NAME="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --output_base) OUTPUT_BASE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --wandb_project) WANDB_PROJECT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        *) echo "Unknown arg: $1"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
done

LOG_DIR="$OUTPUT_BASE/logs"
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
